reviews.title: Great game
reviews.body: This is a super cool game and there is hardly any ads at all. You can learn and get tested on some super cool facts. Like history,science,sports,entertainment,geography, and art. You can also really personalize your questions. This is a very simple process to set up. The questions are hard but not that hard. And they are very fun 🤩 You are so lucky if you get to get this game!!!!!!! There are also a lot of different ways to play it. BEST GAME EVER!!!!!!🥳🥳🥳🥳 You can even look at your stats and see what your good at and what your bad at. You can also pick your opponent and play your best friends. There are also some special challenges that you can complete. 🥇🥇🥇🥇🥇🥇 I don’t think there are any problems at all with this triviatastic game. Although sometimes in the middle of a game it will have an ad but that doesn’t happen a lot. This is my absolute favorite game ever and it is amazing.🤩 Please check this game out and give it a try even if you don’t like it at least try it . It can teach you a lot of great new things about history, science, sports, entertainment, geography, art, and much more. Some questions you might already know and some questions you may not know about but you will have to learn them to win 🏆. In conclusion this is truly an excellent way to learn about many different aspects of our world 🗺️. And beyond 🪐🪐🪐🪐🪐🪐🪐🪐🪐!!!!!! I think you should read this review, try this game out, and share this game with your friends and family. I know that you and your family and friends will love this game!!

reviews.title: Great Game!! Inconvenient Ads :/
reviews.body: I understand the game needs ads to fund making new features and to play the people that produce it. Trust me, I want the people who made this game to make all the money they worked so hard for and more, however, there are so many ads that pop up in the middle of you playing. One of the biggest issues is that I'll answer a question and an ad will pop up!! I just want to play uninterrupted. If the adds only happened once you lost I think this would be a lot better. To clarify, I'm not opposed to ads at all. In fact, I'd be willing to watch ads for advantages like coins, "right answers", or even just hearts (although Imm at a surplus at the moment and don't need more). Another of the biggest problems for me is that sometimes when I press " watch an ad to get another chance" and I actually WILLINGLY sit there and watch an ad, IT DOESNT GIVE ME ANOTHER CHANCE!! I'm sure this is a glitch, but its one that makes me want to stop playing. I love this game. Ive played it off and on for years, same with my mom and a few other family relatives, but with the constant bombardment of ads and the annoying glitches, I can't imagine my interest will be kept. Please fix these issues!! I want to keep playing this game! Again I commend everyone who's worked on this game and I sincerely hope it lasts a long time.

reviews.title: Great game!
reviews.body: Newest update: I got a new iPad and was excited to get the newest version of Trivia Crack. I agree with others who are complaining about the amount of ads that have been added! Not only the over abundance of ads, but some are offensive almost to the point of porn. Surely they can find a less graphic way to portray ads. If it keeps up I will have to delete this app. Update: Been playing this for many years and have enjoyed it until lately. They added a mini game called "Survivor" where you can earn extra coins and bonuses. Unfortunately they're not editing the questions that are submitted and some are poorly worded and sometimes the answers aren't even correct so you can lose without recourse. If you score over 5000 points in a three day game you can win 5000 coins, plus other perks. Supposedly if you score over 10,000 points you get 10,000 coins and double perks, etc. I've scored over 10,000 points a couple different times and have only received 5000 coins. This is so frustrating! When I went to the help section to report it I got an "error" message every time. I'm about ready to delete the whole thing, even though I've always liked playing...till now! I like it a lot. I'm grateful there is a free trivia app I can play. There's a wide range of easy-to-hard questions and you get to play against people from all over the world. There are occasional questions that are worded incorrectly, using improper grammar, and that makes it difficult to understand, but other than that, not too many complaints!

reviews.title: Great Game, WAY too many ads
reviews.body: I love this game, I have always loved this game. I used to play it a really long time ago and recently just picked it up again, it’s just as I remember, with some fun new aspects. I love the fast match, makes it easy to just keep playing. I like the tournaments. They also added a trivia “TikTok” where you scroll and answer questions for coins (unnecessary, but fun I guess). I do love this game, however the gameplay to ad ratio is INSANE. Every time you get a question wrong, thirty second ad. Every time you finish a match (win or lose), fifty second ad. Advertisements surrounding the screen, on the top and bottom, during every game. Every possible trivia question accompanied by “watch an ad to have an advantage” pop up that also halts gameplay. I understand ads, keeps games this awesome free, but there has got to be a limit. Sometimes it’s honestly a deterrent; is this game worth the crazy amount of interruptions that drain my battery? I think that cutting back on ads, maybe just getting rid of the ad after EVERY wrong answer would suffice, would allow the game to be even more enjoyable. Do download this game if you don’t care about that many ads, it really is a great game if you can look past them. However, how hot my (new) phone got just by the amount of ads in 30 minutes of playing might be a reason not to download. (Not to mention I get very awkward very sexual ads; KIDS play these games….)

reviews.title: Ruined their own app
reviews.body: Trivia Crack would be a 5-star game if it weren’t for the insufferable ads that pop up on the screen every 5 seconds. The ads ruin the game for me. Every time I get a question wrong or go to play a mini game, I have to sit through a long ad that I’ve seen a million times before. I never leave reviews but I found the advertisements on this game to be so frustrating that I came here to leave my first review today. When you go to click the X to exit out of an ad, a pop up comes up taking you to the app store download page for that ad. I have to “X out” of their ads 3 times before it actually goes away. I cant even stand being on Trivia Crack for more than 1 minute now. At this point, I spend more time watching ads than I do actually playing the game. The concept of this app is great and it used to be super fun to play, but the ads have completely taken over the app now. I would much rather spend time playing other similar apps than this simply for that reason. It’s very unfortunate because I did used to love to this game, but again, can not handle the insane pop ups and unskippable ads. I’ve spent the last year or so deleting and reinstalling Trivia Crack, each time forgetting how bad the ads really were, but I think this time I will be deleting it permanently and looking for a trivia app or something similar without any of the ads. I’m sure there are better apps out there. Do yourself a favor and don’t waste your time downloading this game.

reviews.title: Great game, needs quality control!
reviews.body: I love this game and have been playing for years. At this point however it really needs some quality control. Users are allowed to submit questions and it seems like there is little or no approval process. I’ve never seen anything directly offensive, so maybe that’s their only criteria?? Anyway, the issues run the gambit between simple misspellings and grammar mistakes to completely false answers. One thing I see a lot of now are questions that have the answer written at the end of the question. I’ve seen more than a few questions that have all the same answer in all four answer options but if you don’t pick the “correct” one you’re still wrong. Some questions just don’t make sense at all and you just have to guess what they are talking about. Some questions are ridiculously easy, like “what’s 2 x 2?” (Seriously!) In “classic mode” you can report questions (with a variety of reporting reasons and comment area) which is great (although who knows if those are even checked?) but in most of the other modes you can’t, like survival, triviatopics, triviathon etc. I paid for the ad free version so it would be nice if they put a little effort into maintaining some quality control. Lastly, you can get a “pet” for your Home Screen. You have to feed it every 18 hours or something. They make it VERRRRRRRY difficult to get the food for it. Game says you can find them in classic mode questions but it’s extremely rare. Duh, they want you to buy them. Anyway, it’s fun. Just don’t expect anything too special, there’s a lot of junk in the game now.

reviews.title: Had potential but was ruined
reviews.body: This game had the potential to be great, but it was ruined by the constant adds, the limits to how many games you can play without purchasing more tries, the pay to win format where you can get every answer correct if you buy them, and the questions that don’t make sense or are outdated. You cannot do anything without being shown at least one add before and after you do it. Every game has the option to automatically get the question right if you pay for it, which takes away the competition aspect and makes games with other player not fun. Many questions are outdated for example I just received a question of “which two YouTubers are currently in a race to 100 million subscribers” this event already took place a year ago and now new YouTubers are in this race but the answer was still Pewdiepie and T-series. I have also received the question “what is the smallest continent” and the answer was Australia, this is not correct because Australia is a country not a continent, the continent is called Oceania and included other countries such as New Zealand along with Australia. There is also a system in the game where you have a very limited amount of games you can play without waiting hours or buying more tries, which is extremely frustrating and take away from the replay-ability. In conclusion the game was originally good, but was then changed to be completely money focused and uncaring to the players experience with all of the micro-transactions and advertisements.

reviews.title: Pretty good game
reviews.body: I actually really like this game. It combines learning education with fun gameplay experiance. Like many games however, this game gives you lives. Lives are annoying in many games but this one in particular is quite different. You get a life every hour and  can have a character that gets you one every 20 hours along with your hourly one. Your lives max out at 3 and i really don't like that. If you say go to sleep, you wont get say 8 or 9 lives. You'll get 3 no matter how many hours you sleep for. Another thing is the question factory. The question factory is a cool way to get your own questions into the game. However, you will send a question and then about 15 minutes later, it will be rejected with a reason of "Repeated Question" Now i've been playing this game for almost a year and i've never seen this question before. One time I made a question, and it got rejected for "spelling and grammar". I triple-checked my question and answers after that and saw no spelling or grammar errors. Part of the question factory is rating questions. You can say if you like the question, don't like the question, or if the question shouldn't be in the game. A lot of players report the question stating false accusations about that question. This is really annoying because you will have your question constantly rejected while there is nothing wrong. Now, if your question does get rejected, you're allowed to change it. This is a good feature, however, most of the time it doesn't let you change it and you just have to resend the question as is. Overall, it is a good game but with some features that need to be changed.

reviews.title: Fun, but Irritating
reviews.body: I like the game as a whole, but I feel like the game lacks any feedback for it's players.  I keep suggesting questions, yet when rejected, I NEVER get a listed reason why.  As an app that is based on community questions, it takes the actual trivial topics, rejects ideas with no reason, and slaps on obvious questions that even a child could find pathetic.  I think there is also confusion in what defines the art category, it has elements like painting and music, but it includes movies, inventions, etc.  There should be more categories included to broaden the variety of questions.  There is also a major issue in the Video Bonuses (as of the newest update) and the submission of questions.  When I click the option to watch an ad for an in-game bonus, an X would immediately appear at the top during the entirety of a sneaker commercial, when the video ended and I waited a minute for something to happen, I hit the X and the app claims that I haven't finished the video.  I have also submitted over 13 questions and their status hasn't changed in MONTHS.  I feel like the older a question is, the less likely it will get picked.  There is no option to remove suggestions or alter them to fix any errors.  The app should allow for the retraction of suggestions and allow for the older questions to be made up front in the "Rate Questions option".  I have enjoyed this app overall, but I will leave an unfavorable review until the developers attend to issues that have plagued the app for months.

reviews.title: Great game…waaaay to many advertisements
reviews.body: I love playing this game. I actually purchased the full version which you would think would eliminate ads. If anything they got worse. Every single thing you do pops up an ad (if not two) in between each game. If I paid for it I shouldn’t have to endure all of these ads trying to sell me more upgrades, etc. or at least give me the option to disable them. It is ridiculous and I want my money back.  Shame on you Etermax for getting people to pay for this and still bombard us with advertisements.Don’t believe me?  Keep reading the reviews here on the App Store.  You will see this complaint all the way back three + years…they don’t care about you.  The very few times that they reply to a complaint on the App Store, they use the same cut and paste response telling you to email their support to tell them your problem.  Etermax, why can’t you answer our questions and complaints here on the App Store reviews?  Everyone should be able to see your lame explaination.  You want us to email you because you don’t want potential new players to see your answer about the ads you force us to endure throughout the  games.  Whatever executive at Etermax made the decision to blast us with ads should be fired for ruining a great game solely for the purpose of fattening the paychecks of him/herself and those who sit on the board.  Do your self a favor people of planet earth…do NOT pay for this game! Shame.  Shame.  Shame.

reviews.title: Love this game...but
reviews.body: I really love this game it is a lot of fun and it keeps me thinking. I also learn fun facts. But the problem is when the videos are supposed to be watched it’s a 1 out of 5 shot that’s the video will actually load and play. You have the videos to get the rewards or more “Little Hearts” to continue to play. Or you have you use your coins. But to get more coins you either have to watch a video (that won’t load) or you have spend actual money. Well not all of us have money like that to spending on games on our phones, I know I don’t I got bills and a family to take care of. If this issue could be taken care of I would give the game 5 stars. Please game makers fix this issue ASAP‼️

reviews.title: This app is a scam.
reviews.body: So I wanted to get this app as a trivia game, (it didn’t advertise that you could earn gift cards in the ads) and making money was a nice bonus. For one though, the only way I can add money to the gift cards is to watch and ad after every 5 or so questions. It doesn’t add anything after I get right answers. Also, you have to watch an ad to HOPEFULLY get money, because it has a “prize machine” and it spins to see what you get. And if you happen to land on the gift card, it only adds about 30 cents. Also, there is a $7.99 monthly subscription payment that shows up it the beginning of the game that has a tiny little slightly darker shade X in the corner, that would easily be missed for little kids. This game is a rip off, it’s not worth it. It’s a somewhat fun trivia game though, they give you 10 lives, and there is no time limit, however there are tons of ads. I think if there were less ads and it actually adds money to your account then it would be very enjoyable. Over all, it’s not a very well-thought out game, and I wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.title: More ads than play
reviews.body: I enjoyed the game a lot until I kept track of actual play time vs ad time. This game averages 12-15 minutes of ad time for 6-8 minutes of actual game time.... in other words, depending on how fast you are able to answers questions, you spend almost TWICE the amount of time waiting for ads to allow you to exit than you do in actually playing the game. While I understand the marketing strategy, I would recommend that players have the option to exit ads prior to 20-30 seconds, and that it would not require multiple clicks to do so. 10 seconds is plenty of time for an ad to get the message across. If the time between ads and play time were more equitable, the star rating would be higher.

reviews.title: So is this a scam or what
reviews.body: It’s starting to seem like this app is a scam in which case I will be reporting it too Apple as such . I will not spend any of my real money on this app til I see I am going to actually be able to cash out any money I Earn playing it . My winnings seem to be stuck at $7.92 and now I’m receiving this Net Request Failed message I’m reading about in the other reviews . I will not reinstall the app because if others are loosing their progress , I’m sure my progress will be lost as well . Also , how can you expect anyone to pay $7.99 a week for an app that doesn’t work properly and isn’t going to allow you to make any money off it . I try my best not to ever leave just 1 star but this app isn’t worth anything more at the moment . Fix these issues and let us earn the money you promise or I will be reporting you to Apple Support . {{UPDATE }}} I will be sharing this apps link with Apple as well as BBB and anybody else I can .

reviews.title: Ads - every 2 - 3 seconds - ads
reviews.body: ... not much play time, but lots and lots of ads. I downloaded this app to play the game, but I can’t play because of all the ads running so often, and sometimes two ads play back-to-back. The game is fun but I’m deleting it tonight because I can’t get any play time. I realize that app developers need to make money to pay the bills, feed the kids, etc - but having ads play EVERY 2 - 3 seconds **Yes, that’s been my experience**, is downright ridiculous. About the time I have read the question, an ad plays before I even have a chance to read the possible answers. I finally get to read the answers, and another ad plays. I press my answer selection, and another ad plays - sometimes two ads play. Once I make the correct selection, another ad plays. I select “Next” to go to the next question, and big surprise - ANOTHER ad plays. It’s incredibly frustrating, especially when I’m playing to calm down at bedtime!I  set my time limit for daily playing of this game at 5 minutes, and I spend over half of that time watching ads. And almost all of the ads are for VERY violent and disturbing games - I would be embarrassed to recommend this game to anyone because of the amount of ads, and because of the nature of the ads.To steal a line, “Stick a fork in me, I think I’m done!”

reviews.title: It will steal your money!
reviews.body: This app is absolutely HORRIBLE! It doesn’t work and it will automatically take money from your account even after you un-install it! I saw an ad for this app so I downloaded it and started a free trial even though it was for my card information I thought it was just to add the money on my card. I ended up deleting the app after having it for a day because it’s not worth it. Then 2 days later (after the free trial) they charged me a monthly subscription fee for a app I deleted! I deleted the app and had to go into my settings to make sure they didn’t charge me next month mind you I didn’t even have the app on my phone they just had me card information! I emailed the owner of this app and didn’t get a response. I tried to dispute and refund the order but I couldn’t. Don’t get caught up in the “free money” hype this app definently is a CON! If I could rate it ZERO stars I would! WASTE OF TIME AND WILL STEAL YOUR MONEY BEAWARE!!!

reviews.title: I’m disappointed
reviews.body: Don’t get this app, it’ll disappoint you. I’m trying to randomly play and get more coins to get gift cards , but when I try to watch the ads to get more coins it just says ‘failed to watch video’ now I’ve been deleting and getting this app back thinking it’s the app cause I know my wifi is perfectly up and running including full bars, so I literally have to wait a few days to get the 10 lives back just cause it won’t let me watch the ad to get more lives. Another reason why I give this app two stars is because it’s hard to win more in your balance, Ive been only getting a few cents every time, wasting my coins to get more lives, I ran out of coins and it still has an option to watch an ad to get 2 lives and I can’t even watch them My balance has been at 6 for a while now just cause you don’t get much

reviews.title: Loss
reviews.body: So as much as I can say it’s legit game......data do not restore, nor save, nor any option to sign up via email, except it saves your paid for no ads????? I tried to find every way I can to sign up via email or Facebook, that way it will save all times I used to do the quiz and grow the investment I have earned with QuizTime, will vanish into thin air once you reset your devices or delete app for any reasons and there’s no option for me to contact app developer nor support. Unless I’m wrong and I get any kind of message sent to me for help and discussion how to restore all data I worked for, I will not update the review and stars. I hope app developers will contact me soon. I enjoy the game. It’s fun. And easy. Good for people with ADHD and Autism who has gifted of acknowledgement of specific details. I can’t earn any prize if I do something to my phone without attempt delete the data on my own term.

reviews.title: Ad After Every Question
reviews.body: So it is what I said, it plays an ad after every single question!!!!! Is that suppose to be fun or make the game enjoyable??? Because it’s not, why not just make an app to play ads…….because basically that’s what you’ve done. Deleting app and giving 1 star……I’d give you NO STARS if that was an option but as it stands I had to put 1 star…..it’s not even worth that ……it’s really not worth the time it took …even to write this review but I wrote it so others will know NOT to download it because it’s a waste of time…..literally it plays and ad after every single question be it the write answer or not. I don’t think the App Store should even allow this to be downloaded……huge waste of time and space on my phone….NEXT!!!!!!

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.body: I downloaded this free game because I like trivia games, I already have one on my phone but this one looked really fun. I started playing but it was taking forever to load each question and log onto the game. I waited patiently for a while after each question but I became super annoyed. Like, if I tapped a button it wouldn't work and I would have to do it over and over again. SUPER ANNOYING. It kept saying that there was no internet connection. I checked my WiFi and it was fine though. Also there was a lot of ads, pretty much after every question. I thought the questions were pretty difficult but that might just be because I'm dumb lol. Conclusion: Please don't download this game. It's very slow and has a lot of ads.

reviews.title: The best trivia app I’ve ever played!!
reviews.body: It’s the only one I’ve ever kept on my tablet for more than 2 days. It’s a winner and it’s fun. That leads me into the one complaint I have about the game. Your score is based on how quickly you answer the questions. Sometimes one or more of the answers to choose from cracks me up and makes me laugh. Although the sense of humor is greatly appreciated and refreshing, it slows me down and therefore affects my score. <just kidding>EDIT: I’ve come across a situation that I  believe should be changed. When you miss an answer, you’re presented with a heart you’ve accumulated. Play the heart and get another chance. Sounds great. Except you’re not given the option to use it or not. If it’s the first or second question, it would be a waste to use it. Save it for the time when you can use it for a much higher rated question to give you a better chance of finishing the quiz.DEVELOPERS: Please give consideration to this change. Thx

reviews.title: One little issue, some reviews I don't rlly like.....
reviews.body: Hey, so I like the game, don't get me wrong. I love all the tricky questions and categories. But...I've been playing for a few days and I noticed, every thing costs of coins. Now, it would be okay if a few things costs of coins. I get that. But..I just don't like how EVERYTHING costs of gems, or coins. For example, I got an answer wrong and it said 100 coins (if that's the number, I forgot) to continue. That's just ridiculous. 100 coins (or gems) JUST to CONTINUE?? That's so wrong. Even the other games I play don't cost coins to continue. Continuing on to another level is a thing that you do in all games. I'm sorry, but you NEED to change that if you can. Now, I really don't agree with the other reviews people write because, for the people who were complaining about losing, it's fine. I lose all the time. People lose. You have to get over it. If you don't know it, try your best! If I don't know something, I just guess and if I get it wrong, I get it wrong! It's part of a game. And if people are complaining about glitches, there's no glitches! I swear, I've been playing for a few days and I've never encountered ANY glitches. If you have had a few glitches, it's probably your iPad or phone or something. My iPad and phone run smoothly. If yours doesn't, that's probably the problem. And listen, if people don't really like my review, REMEMBER, this is just MY opinion, okay? I'm not trying to be rude here, but if your hating on my review just because I have a different opinion than you, I may sound a little rude. So, for all those things, and some bad reviews, I give it a 9 out of 10. I hope you understand. Have a good day/night everyone!! :D

reviews.title: Very enjoyable
reviews.body: I have been enjoying this game for a few months now, up to level 870. Enjoying the various categories since I’m good at some and not others but there’s a lot of diversity. It is random that the Poetry category is mostly nursery rhymes but I can live with it since I know more nursery rhymes than poetry it seems.Some reviews so they have issues getting rewards for watching videos, if my reward doesn’t pop up after the first ad, I have been exiting and closing game app and then opening it again, which seems to do the trick. My only “complaint” or thing I’d like to see changed is that you should always gain coins for each round completed. Even if it’s only 25 or 50 coins, you should always be receiving more coins than you started, not just breaking even. I may get a reward multiplier chest greater than 2x less than a quarter of the time. That’s frustrating since you need the coins to increase the experts. I understand there may be a desire to have people purchase coins or watch ads but I think you could at least adjust it so you always earn at least a little more than 100 coins. Maybe just eliminate the 2x multiplier and let 3x be the smallest. Thanks for an enjoyable game!

reviews.title: Finally Deleted for Good
reviews.body: I have given this app shot after shot because there are limited trivia games out there to choose from that aren’t inane. But I am finally deleting for good.  Too many issues - when you get up in the higher levels, the questions are ridiculously obscure and impossible to answer (e.g. who won the South African amateur golf championship in 2012) and in some cases I have found the app to be wrong!! Which costs you.  I get that they want you to use gems and promote purchases, but come on…..Then when I reached well into level 9 in a few of the categories, and I’m answering and I am answering question 3 out of the 7, I get a message that says “you have reached the end of questions in this category” and it just takes me back to the Home Screen.  I’m sorry….what??? And right in the middle of a session where I have already used gems and am in need of a finished round for a tournament or something. Bottom line, it’s kinda fun in the beginning but will quickly become infuriating as you progress through the higher levels. The obscurity of the questions and the volatility of the “experts” answering just makes this app go from relaxing to throw-your-phone-out-of-the-window frustrating. I want an app for relaxation and challenge not to illicit rage from me.

reviews.title: Tournament problems
reviews.body: I’m getting ready to delete this game, even though I really like it. I would have given it 5 stars at first, but not any more. The problem is the tournaments. This is my favorite part of the game. I put in time and effort to climb the leaderboard, get 1st place, and advance to the next higher level of the tournament. But I cannot get past the Silver 1 level, even though I get first place. This has happened multiple times!! Let me paint a picture for you. This is what happened last night. I’m on the Silver 1 level, I work hard, use my coins and rubies, build a huge lead. I check on it a few minutes before the tournament is over, and see that my huge lead remains. Then I go to bed. This morning, I check on it. The game congratulates me on getting first place. I receive my prizes. I’m feeling good. Finally, I’m moving on to Gold levels! I click the tournament button to begin, and I see that I’ve been demoted to Silver 3. Why? The game told me I won!!!!! I’m so angry. I’m angry because I like the game, because I want the game to work properly. I’m angry because of all the wasted hours! There is either a glitch in the game, or there are not enough people playing it to have Gold levels and beyond. Either way, I’m upset, and I’m not going to waste any more time on this game.

reviews.title: Very easy & WAY too many Ads!!!
reviews.body: You’d have to be really living under a rock to not get most of the answers to these questions in any category in a second. Really. It was fun for a little while even though it was super easy, and I would have honestly kept playing just for fun, but there is, no exaggeration, a 30+ second Ad after EACH very short set of 3 questions. Each set of 3 questions takes LESS than a minute to answer, so that’s a 30 second Ad, basically EVERY MINUTE. That is just way too many Ads. I play a lot of free games, and Ads are expected (that is of course how the game is “free”) but the cost of my time watching a 39 second Ad literally every minute, is just not worth the fun of this easy game, so deleted it had to be. If you slowed down your ads to one every 5 minutes, that would be at least be a bearable improvement (maybe). Other than the fact that it will take you forever to get ahead in this easy game, simply because there are so many ads, it was fun. Don’t be so greedy, guys. You have to strike a balance between making money from Ads and not having SO MANY Ads that you loose your audience.

reviews.title: Trivia
reviews.body: Very fun game that actually plays as advertised. Many of these games advertise one way then when you download them they are nothing like what you thought you were getting. This game is fun, starts off easy and gets more challenging and has multiple fun trivia categories and fun ways to get coins and points. No glitches either. The only thing that I think is worth it is getting rid of the ads. Once you see if you like the actual game I got rid of the ads for a 4.99 one time fee. WELL worth no interruptions! I have actually ditched some of my other games on my tablet and find myself always playing this at the end of the night. LOVE IT!! You don’t have to be a genius because there’s always ways where you can get hints. But it’s challenging enough for people that are actually very smart and don’t need the hints that they are challenged as well the further and further along you get in the game.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.body: I really wanted to like this game. It has some great aspects of it. The reason I’m leaving a 2 star review is because of how money hungry the company who makes this game seems. You obviously have people spending real life money on it, so why do you feel the need to spam ads. After you complete the 3-5 questions. Depending on the category you choose. You are then forced to watch an ad, and it’s not your normal ads that play for a few seconds, then let you skip. No you click skip, then have to close out your iTunes, or google play whichever OS your using. Then have to wait again to skip the ad again. All together you’re closing the ad 3 times, then being bombarded with “deals” to try and get you to spend more real money. You can bug VIP, but all that does is get rid of the ads. You’ll still end up spending loads of money because they use diamonds to be able to re roll, or ask an expert, or 50/50 split. These are the reasons why I’ll be deleting this game, and not recommending it to others. The desperation for people to spend money ruins the whole game experience for what otherwise would be a fantastic trivia game.

reviews.title: Incorrect answers, expensive gems, Too many categories I didn’t like
reviews.body: I have been playing this trivia game for several months now. Until recently, I have not had any trouble earning coins. But now the categories are so not me that I’m losing coins. The gems are so time-consuming to earn for free by watching the ads, so I can’t spend them re-rolling questions or 50-50 or re-rolling the category. All the questions in the birds category have to do with the Latin names of birds and bird body parts. All the questions in the poetry category are nursery rhymes!! There have been so many incorrect answers where I lose my game because I got it “wrong”. I really don’t know where they get their questions because so many are so random and abstract I get very frustrated getting all the incorrect answers. The mythology category is so difficult you have to know india and Norse and a lot of mythology’s that most people aren’t familiar with. I finally got so fed up tonight with an incorrect answer and the fact that I had to spend hundreds of coins to try to earn a special Sunday gem earning opportunity that I just got mad and deleted the program.

reviews.title: Seemed ok
reviews.body: It seemed ok to start with plenty of trivia questions in different categories.  Over time though you begin to need to answer more questions to beat the levels and that feature just doesn’t make sense to me.  Sure maybe make that increase as you go up levels in that category like answering 6 questions on a level 5 category, but if you leave categories low because you don’t know them well it makes no sense to make you answer 6 questions when you haven’t leveled that category up at all.  My biggest complaint is with the tournaments.  I was gold III for one… exited the game around an hour before end time and I was 6th place… come back on after that tournament ended… next one started and I’m down to silver II… I have trouble imagining that I dropped down from 6 to the bottom 10 when I’d been in the top 10 most of the tournament and even if I did why did I drop 2 levels. It makes no sense.  Seriously considering deleting between the frustration with that ad needing to answer more and more questions in areas I don’t know.

reviews.title: Great game!
reviews.body: I like this game, but truly only reviewed it in hopes that it’ll stop popping up asking me to review every other round. So, a real review after playing for a while. This is one of the few games I don’t mind paying for, so I never see ads and I think I have unlimited lives (I’ve not hit the limit, anyway); I enjoy the questions and the little events, though I do wish there were more of them. It’s a nice little game for those who enjoy trivia. It also helps me when I go play trivia out in the real world. The only odd thing is, is everyone a bot? I ask because, it doesn’t matter what time I play, the 6 people I’m playing with right now, are, somehow, always up to play. Literally, I can play a round at 8am, they all come and play within seconds of each other. I can play at noon, they all come play within seconds of each other. I can play at 10pm, they all come play within seconds of each other. I can literally wake up at 4 am and play a round, and they all come play within moments of each other. Could they all just happen to always be up at the same time as me, and each other? Maybe, but seems a bit odd. Like, I’ve purposely played at very odd times just to see, and they all always play within minutes of me, and every single one of them. Either everyone who plays is always on their phones or they’re bots or something.

reviews.title: Bugs and ad’s
reviews.body: I would 100% give this 5 stars as this game is enjoyable and a fun way to enhance your knowledge in a multitude of subjects. However, I have some issues. (Number 4 is more specific to me but it should be acknowledged)1. The amount of ad’s are insane and sometimes they even cause the app to crash and causes me to lose the game or that question. Even after I purchased no ads, when I use an ad for help it is a 50/50 chance it will crash2. The constant crashing of the game irritates me beyond explanation. The game will freeze, crash, etc. and seems to be a way to try and force players to use their coins and/or spend money on the game. 3. It needs more decks pertaining to a wide variety of topics. I would love more topics about anatomy, or other tv shows such as how I met your mother, or really anything else. Because most of the time my questions from random tend to largely be about George Washington, Peyton manning, and other presidents. 4. Also, when I block someone It should block them. I have almost deleted this app several times because of creepy men trying to “pick me up” in the trivia crack chat room. Trivia crack needs to allow for actual blocking (I blocked someone and they could still play me even after I tried to block them again) and allow for explanation or reporting of why we blocked them. I should be allowed to play this game without 34-50 year olds trying to get my social media or phone number.

reviews.title: Bugs and Small Fixes
reviews.body: I’ve played the game for a few weeks now, and as I tried to escape playing the repetitive gameplay, I stumbled upon some bugs that I would like to be fixed. First off, I started playing this game with a couple friends who have surprisingly not left the game yet, so some merit for that I guess, I tried to access the online multiplayer feature “Tower Duels,” for it prompts you to play with your friend by sending them a “request.” Unfortunately, this request is never sent and can cause some crashes if specific criteria are met. Second, I understand that ads are a key part of the games revenue and you’ve made up for it by putting in free ways to get game currency, but the amount of ads is atrocious, I feel it would be fair that if after a game when it prompts you to “Watch an ad for a second chance,” if you decline it shouldn’t give you an ad! Finally, I do very much enjoy this game and I appreciate the thoroughness and up to date questions but after a while of playing you will easily see 2 or 3 of the same question appear. Thank you for reading!Sincerely,Witho

reviews.title: Classic Sequel
reviews.body: I loved Trivia Crack, played it with all my friends, but after a while it got a tad boring. We moved on, but we we saw trivia crack 2 come out. We all decided to get it, and my friends are bored of it again, but I actually enjoy it. Especially with the new game modes, I can really have fun playing against random people, something I never did with the first one. However, there are a lot more ads in this one, along with the nonsense notifications. The app on my phone will have a little ‘1’ on the top right of the picture, showing me I have a notification. This could either mean someone played me back, or there’s a special offer, or something like that.  Instead, when I go into the app, there is no notification, just something to make me launch the game to check.  The new game mode in which I forgot the name, the one where there’s a time limit and you have 10 attempts to win the majority of categories against an opponent, has too many ads as well. I was doing extremely well in a few games, causing me to get double digit questions correctly in a row in my preferred categories, but I was forced to watch an ad after every single wrong answer, leaving me to run out of time and not being able to play all 10 of my tries, resulting in a loss against my opponent. This is a game breaking advertising move, and I hate it. I am now going to delete the game, considering all my friends have done the same, and I can’t play against random people without half my time being spent watching a ‘Toy Blast’ ad. Was fun for a week tho. 2 stars.

reviews.title: “Complete rip off”
reviews.body: This game is fun but it is a total rip off to have to pay to get more lives in order to play anymore games or to have to wait a long time to get another life. Plus the prices are a total rip off as well and the developers of this game are like stealing money from everyone and ripping everyone off just to get more lives in order to keep playing the game. It should be free, you should not have to pay anything. This happened to me when I first got this game and then when I saw how much money these robbers are trying to get everyone to pay for different amounts of lives to keep playing the game I just laughed and was like I don’t think so robbers. Shame on the developers of this game for ripping everyone off and stealing.   The developers of Trivia crack game are very greedy, there ripping all of us off and all they care about is money from you.  Trivia crack should not be charging you and ripping everyone off for running out of lives and having to buy more lives and games should be free and unlimited.    Trivia crack 2 is now making you have to get tokens or whatever the freak it is to be able to invite friends, what a rip off.  everything about trivia crack is about money or being limited or in some cases you have to collect or wait to play, that’s not a good fair game.  being greedy and ripping us all off and stealing money from us all is not a good developer.

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.body: I love the actual content of the game. The different game modes are fun and there are a lot of them to choose from. The questions are usually good. However, the game suffers from having WAY too many ads. I completely understand that the developers want to monetize the game through ads, that’s completely fine. But this game is completely jam packed with them! Alongside banners, there are ads every single time you exit a portion of the game (when you get a question wrong and lose your turn, when you win a game, when you exit back to the main menu). This gets old pretty quickly, especially when the ads are 30 seconds long and usually not skippable. Sure, you can swipe away from the app, but that gets rid of any positive progress you made (winning, getting questions right, etc) and saves any negative progress you made (losing, getting a question wrong). I got extremely fed up with this when i started getting ads for no reason every 5 questions in the middle of a game.I get the need to monetize the game. But I think the developers should either reduce the number of ads or at least offer a payment option to get rid of them (like was present in trivia crack 1)- a small payment rather than an expensive subscription. The excess ads cover up what is a really good game underneath.

reviews.title: Frustrated.
reviews.body: So at first when I downloaded this app I was super excited and really liked it. But as I continue to try to do the daily challenges I become more and more frustrated.  There are questions that have completely wrong answers but you can’t flag them because as soon as you get it wrong (by selecting the CORRECT answer), there is a pop up and if you just close it out it gives you your percentage of “right” answers.  It doesn’t let you actually flag the question as having an incorrect answer.  On the same side of the coin there are questions in the daily challenges that have answers that are so long, wordy, and grammatically incorrect that you just have to pick one before time runs out not knowing if you picked the right answer.  Again just frustrating, I understand they are supposed to be rapid fire questions, but there should still be away to “report questions” like you can in the first one so more people don’t get frustrated and just delete the app and spread the word that a trivia game has incorrect answers and no way for players to try and fix them.

reviews.title: Poor and greedy design
reviews.body: The entire nature of the UI of this game is designed to keep children or impulsive people glued to the screen at all times in an effort to get them to spend money. Everything is flashing at you or begging for your attention with exclamation marks and pulsing images. There is an ad on your screen at all times, including full screen pop up’s occasionally. There are also paid loot boxes in the game which most certainly promote gambling in children and other impulsive people. While this scheme exists in many games of its type, it’s just icing on the cake with all of the other blatant attempts to milk money out of the player. Now don’t get me wrong, I understand that everyone needs to make money to pay for server costs and staffing and such, but when you already have plenty of other games on the store (all tagging on the original success of trivia crack), there is likely no need for such an aggressive money scheme for any reason besides greed. The UI itself is also quite unintuitive, with an unclear system on viewing active games, and the always viewable option on the main menu existing only to start new games. While I understood this quite quickly, I currently have 8 active games with a friend who didn’t understand this. Also there is no option to turn off random games being started with you via a random person. If I do not want to start a game with a random person online, don’t send me invitations to do so. Whether they searched for me or found me by pressing the random button, I would like a setting that disables this. Some of the trivia questions are good, but some of them are very bland or of a low knowledge level to the point where you don’t need to know the answer 100% to answer and it just feels free. Some questions I’ve found to not even fit their respective categories.

reviews.title: Buggy Cash Grab
reviews.body: The title says it all. Even the developers know this is true. It isn’t really different at all from the first Trivia Crack. Except now be prepared to watch ads to literally do anything. I get it, it’s a free app and they make money with ad space, but this is excessive and I think it might be a reason why the game freezes up and crashes frequently (which is especially annoying when you're doing a real-time trivia match). Moreover, during a real-time battle where the whole point is to answer questions quickly, get ready to randomly sit through a 30 second ad as your time ticks away and your opponent shoots ahead. They removed the statistics function from the first trivia crack (probably because they got found out for having fake bot players for users to play against). You also can’t compare your rank with your friends to show off, which kills off some of the competitive feel. I played this game for a good while and got to about level 120 but the frequent app freezing and excessively ads UNNECESSARILY interfere with the game too much and I’m just over it. I love trivia and the idea behind the game, but I’m not gonna shell out monthly payments to simply not have annoying interferences.

reviews.title: Love the mental workout - 5 Stars
reviews.body: I really love this game. I play it often but I have to be careful because I’m super competitive and can’t back away from a group challenge. Luckily I’ve won quite a few but when I lose I act like an imbecile.  I’m alone and yelling obscenities at my phone. I get a terrific laugh at my own ridiculous behavior and then go right back for more. I actually play for about a half hour before Jeopardy starts to warm up my brain. It’s actually improved my ability to run a category and gets me in the zone for quizzes of any kind. I enjoy switching back and forth from easy mode and hard mode depending on my mood and current confidence level. It’s better than the other games I’ve sought out for keeping my brain functioning at its best and has great diversity of questions compared to other games I’ve played. I’m just a nerdy girl at heart and I love learning. I’ll keep playing unless I break my phone while screaming expletives at it because I just made a foolish choice by not trusting my instincts. Thanks ;-)

But I kept playing, then someone with the game would manipulate it to make it so I would not get as many points for doing things and answering the questions correctly. reviews.title: WONDERFUL UPDATES!!
reviews.body: I have been playing Quizzland off and on for years; my biggest complaint was that if you play the game fast, eventually the stars awarded for the correctly answered question would not be added to your grand total.  It was a computer glitch.With the recent game update, I can quickly answer trivia questions and have my awarded stars added to the grand total without the computer glitch! Also, it's nice to see that the extra games and game exit are delinated as different shapes than the square-shaped Trivia Questions; this is useful, because I skip the Extra Games (Before, the Extra Games and Game Exit icons were square-shaped, just like the Trivia questions- it was easy to press on the Game exit and Extra Games without meaning to).Finally, for the Treasure Chest game, in the past, if you selected the chest with coins, it would not award you any coins; with the new update, it adds the coin value to your overall total.I am super happy with the great updates- keep up the excellent work!!In the future, it would be great to have a Chat function built into the game, so you can talk with fellow players 👍🤗

reviews.title: Good game except for
reviews.body: Update:I did receive a response very quickly and they said add should close out within 5 seconds. And if the issue persists, send them a screenshot under report a problem. The problem with that is there is no way to upload or copy & paste a photo so I’m back in the same boat. Original review:This could be a really fun game except for the stupid pop ups that you cannot X out of. The screen stays the same and no matter how long you keep the screen open, you’re forced to close out the game and open it again. I’m on level 4 had had to do this a half dozen times already. Major inconvenience and makes me not want to play.

reviews.title: Getting frustrated
reviews.body: Update: I took the developers' advise and did the update. The reason I'm loathe to update is I find it doesn't usually help, and often makes things worse. Now, instead of being kicked off about 5 times a game, it's "only" 2or 3. But now, instead of taking 10-15 seconds to load, it takes 30! Don't think I gained anything.This used to be my favorite app but lately it's getting too frustrating to play. I loved almost everything about it when I started but now it freezes up and kicks me off, sometimes two or three times a game. It's especially maddening when it loses me legitimately earned points/coins. I've written to the developers and they give me the old "we're aware of the glitch and working on it" but weeks later it's still happening. I may have to uninstall if it keeps on...not worth the frustration.

reviews.title: New Obsession
reviews.body: This game is becoming my new obsession.  As many others, I like the explanations to each answer at the end.  It’s like playing “who wants to be a millionaire.”  The only concern I have are the comments from individuals.  I’m not pleased to see that there  are political, racist, sexist and totally irrelevant comments about the questions or explanations.  It only took one time for me to see those, to not look at them again.   Plus, I just don’t think that this feature is necessary in any game.  There’s enough social media out there.  It doesn’t need to start creeping into our entertainment and relaxation time!But, again, the game is great!

reviews.title: The Game is Good, but has Some Problems
reviews.body: I’m really enjoying the game, even though I have just started it. As I was playing an ad popped up. I watched it and then press the “x”. When I got back to actually playing the game it said that I ran out of time and automatically said I lost. It went from the ad screen to the fail screen even though I didn’t get to see the question before the ad. I brushed it off and kept playing. It happened to me two more times. I went to report it, but the “report it” button was very useless for someone trying to report something rather than to “ask questions”. I know this review kind of sounds negative, but the game is really good other than those problems. Thank you!

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.body: When I first started playing this game I found it fun, interesting and educational. However now it’s becoming annoying as so many games are with an incredible amount of annoying ads which can’t be skipped as easy as the developers say. I answer 4 or 5 questions…ad…a few more questions…ad, etc. Wasn’t that way originally. Will soon delete and hopefully find something better. Just recently received response from developers, I have never run into an ad I can skip in 5 seconds as you state, most take 30+ seconds and more…some over a minute to skip. Don’t get me wrong I understand the importance of ads to you but when they go from reasonable to annoying as they are now it’s time to find something else.

reviews.title: Tomato isn’t a veggie.
reviews.body: I really wasn’t sure about this game due to the ad that I was shown. When the interactive part came up on the ad the question was tomato is a…. So I selected fruit (because it is a fruit) and it said I was wrong and that it’s a veggie and I was like oh wow and I’m downloading this game and there are questions with the wrong answer on there I don’t even want to play it now… however it’s a decent game and gets you thinking and gives you the option to change difficulty. However I think you should fix the error on that ad or if that question appears in the game make sure the proper answer is the correct answer a lot of people think it’s a veggie but it isn’t.
